descriptionChirho: The proper name Rezin (רְצִין), referring primarily to the king of Aram-Damascus in the time of Ahaz and Isaiah, and possibly also to a family head among the temple servants (Nethinim) in Ezra. The two clusters are transliteration variants of the same name: eng Retsin/Rezin, spa Resín/Retsin, hin रत्सीन/रेसीन, arb رَصِينَ/רָخִינוּ, kor 르신이/르신과, swa Resini/Resini. All 11 occurrences refer to the same proper noun with no semantic distinction between the clusters.
